title: Vanilla Exploring+
description: This modpack adds a variety of mods to improve exploration while keeping the vanilla style.
body:
### Vanilla Exploring+

Vanilla Exploring+ expands Minecraft’s sense of adventure while preserving the charm and balance of the vanilla game. The modpack focuses on exploration, discovery, and immersion, giving players more reasons to venture into the unknown without overwhelming the original Minecraft experience.

Travel through a world filled with new landmarks, improved terrain generation, and expanded dimensions. Discover hidden structures, uncover forgotten secrets, and experience familiar places in a fresh way. Every addition is carefully selected to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft.

Features

🗺️ Expanded Exploration

Many new structures to discover across the Overworld
Improved and expanded vanilla structures
Enhanced world generation with more variety and atmosphere
More rewarding exploration and adventure

🌌 Improved Dimensions

A completely reworked End dimension with new sights and challenges
A brand-new Deep Dark dimension to explore
More reasons to travel beyond the Overworld

⚔️ New Content

New armor and equipment
A starter kit to help begin your journey
Additional surprises and hidden features throughout the world

✨ Quality of Life & Visual Improvements

Improved gameplay feel and immersion
Full shader support
Performance and optimization enhancements
Carefully selected features that stay true to the vanilla style
Philosophy

Vanilla Exploring+ is designed for players who love the feeling of discovering something new while keeping Minecraft recognizable. Instead of completely changing the game, it builds upon the existing experience, making exploration more exciting, dimensions more interesting, and the world feel larger and more alive.

Explore further. Discover more. Stay vanilla.
